subject.why: The bowler hat is instantly recognisable, complete with its rounded crown, brim, band, and the requested red carnation.

category.why: The composition correctly features a plain flat yellow surface and a smooth yellow wall gradient behind it, matching Category 2 requirements.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The hat is nicely centered with ample margins around all edges.

colour.why: Bright and warm with high contrast between the black hat, red carnation, and sunny yellow background.

detail.why: There is an extra prop (a magnifying glass) placed in front of the hat, which violates the single-object focus and the rule against extra unrequested props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky volumes, clean satin sheen, and no outlines, matching the game's art style.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (99% of the background); planned yellow

fix: Remove the magnifying glass so the bowler hat and its carnation are the sole focus.
